description.value: Rain or Shine is a well-regarded Vancouver homemade ice cream brand with three city locations, crafting Philadelphia-style scoops using locally sourced BC dairy and regionally foraged ingredients. The Cambie Village shop sits on one of Vancouver's primary cycling corridors, making it a natural mid-ride stop. The rotating menu spans classics like Salted Caramel and Chocolate alongside inventive flavours like London Fog and Honey Lavender, with dedicated vegan and gluten-free offerings throughout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record targets the Cambie Village location at 3382 Cambie Street; the website contact page explicitly confirms this address with a dedicated phone number (604.876.9986) not present in OSM. The website corroborates the OSM diet:vegan=yes tag with several labelled vegan flavours and widespread gluten-free/egg-free callouts. None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) appear anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; 604.876.9986 sourced from the website contact page specifically for the Cambie Village location.

Website footer displays 1926 West 4th Ave (Kits location) as the default/primary address, which differs from the OSM address; however the contact page explicitly lists 3382 Cambie Street as the Cambie Village location, confirming the OSM address is correct for this record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, well-established business on a major Vancouver cycling corridor, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence; on-site verification is needed before listing.
